aboutParagraph1:
Background & Vision:

The fusion of visual creation and an engineering mindset defines me. I started as a video editor (TV2), which helps me think in user-friendly and aesthetic solutions as a developer.
aboutParagraph2:
Studies:

I mastered the basics of software development during my vocational training, graduating with excellent results. The next step in my professional growth is the Computer Engineering program at Óbuda University, which I started in the autumn of 2025.
aboutParagraph3:
Professional Focus:

As a web developer, I build on solid foundations, but I constantly expand my technological horizons. My attention has now turned to native mobile applications: currently, mastering Swift and implementing more complex, platform-specific solutions is my goal.
